problem: Native Word RTF files exposed over-restrictive metadata/table/drawing grammars. Native Excel XLS worksheet failures were silently discarded, causing incomplete eager catalogs and public query failures even when source text reads succeeded.

rtf: Retain empty file tables and native passive mail-merge settings; accept the native unstarred query/source text forms.
Distinguish repeated table-style IDs by conditional region; prefer the unscoped base for typed lookup and transfer every definition.
Reset itap with pard so outer cell text does not enter a stale nested table.
Allow typed move-bookmark destinations inside revisions while continuing to reject active destinations.
Read unstarred shape-group results, direct legacy polygon primitives and exact duplicate section-numbering defaults repeated after body text.
xls: Propagate worksheet errors rather than suppressing them and dropping catalog entries.
Read optional native DCon self-reference padding and ignore padding contents; ignore the PLS reserved prefix.
Read Feature11/12 actual ranges from the feature body, ignoring their FrtRefHeaderU ref8; accept producer version 0xF.
Retain native sort-condition ranges independently of SortData; authoring add() still checks containment.
Preserve larger legacy conditional-format groups and shared-formula anchors anywhere within their declared range, required by existing tracked regression fixtures now that parse errors propagate.

Update two frozen first-error expectations to the original worksheet errors, and repin the SST corpus digest after the native fixture merge. All tracked XLS fixtures are materialized and no untracked XLS files contributed.
ci: Enable all eight Office leaves plus encryption in facade-format-tests.
Bind 23 concrete native tests to 36 fixtures and 34 partial feature rows; require facade gate features to include the indexed native tests.
